portal_hypertension.title: Prognostic scores for early mortality following transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt insertion: external validation in a contemporary Australian cohort.
portal_hypertension.authors: Walia N, Nilsen O, Cheung E
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 117）。核心观点：传统的评分系统，例如终末期肝病模型 (MELD) 和 MELD-Na，以及较新的改良 TIPS 评分 (MOTS) 和 TIPS 后弗莱堡生存指数 (FIPS)，已显示出细化风险分层的潜力。 临床提示：外部验证预测 TIPS 后 30 天和 90 天死亡率的预后评分。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Mortality following transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) placement remains a critical concern. Traditional scoring systems, such as the Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) and MELD-Na, as well as the newer Modified TIPS-Score (MOTS) and Freiburg Index of Post-TIPS Survival (FIPS), have shown potential for refining risk stratification. To externally validate prognostic scores for predicting 30- and 90-day mortality following TIPS. This retrospective study, conducted at Austin Health, Australia, included 117 patients who underwent TIPS with ≥90 days of follow-up between 2011 and 2024. portal_hypertension.title: A noninvasive model for predicting intrahepatic venovenous shunts before HVPG measurement: a multiple cohort study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Chen R, Ma L, Liu Y
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 194）。核心观点：本研究旨在构建机器学习（ML）模型，以便在肝静脉压力梯度（HVPG）测量之前无创识别中度至重度肝内静脉分流（MS-IHVS）。 临床提示：回顾性纳入 605 名接受 HVPG 测量的患者进行模型开发。
portal_hypertension.abstract: This study aimed to construct a machine learning (ML) model to facilitate non-invasive identification of moderate-to-severe intrahepatic venovenous shunts (MS-IHVS) before hepatic venous pressure gradient (HVPG) measurement. A total of 605 patients receiving HVPG measurement were retrospectively included for model development. Two validation cohorts were used: an FN-validation cohort (n = 194; retrospectively enrolled) with both wedged hepatic venous pressure (WHVP) and fine-needle (21-22G) portal venous pressure (FN-PVP) measurements, and a TIPS-validation cohort (n = 92; prospectively enrolled with WHVP and direct PVP measurements. portal_hypertension.title: Clinical presentation, management, and outcomes for noncirrhotic portal hypertension in children.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of pediatric gastroenterology and nutrition
portal_hypertension.authors: Jarasvaraparn C, Ferrante-Gennaro GE, Tolliver KM
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 63）。核心观点：非肝硬化门静脉高压（​​NCPH）是一种罕见疾病，其特征是在没有肝硬化的情况下门静脉压力升高，由肝内和肝外途径引起。 临床提示：本研究旨在描述儿童 NCPH 的特征、病因、临床表现和结局。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Noncirrhotic portal hypertension (NCPH) is a rare condition marked by elevated portal venous pressure in the absence of cirrhosis and is caused by intrahepatic and extrahepatic pathways. This study aimed to describe the characteristics, etiologies, clinical manifestations, and outcomes of NCPH in children. This study was a retrospective chart review of 63 patients in a single tertiary center. Participants were children (≤18 years old) diagnosed with portal hypertension in the absence of cirrhosis.
